text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean quantile score of each of the seeds 11 to 15, over the five decision substations, leads 0.5 to 168 hours. Each dot is one seed's own forecast; the headline arms average the five seeds' quantiles. GAM-K has no seed.'
